task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Two mismatches. (1) The clause 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' should be Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled), but the candidate has the propositions reversed: Response(switch_toggled, siren_ringing) requires the siren to ring after every toggle, an added requirement the task never states. Swap the propositions. (2) 'Go to the exit' is an unconditional command with no preference cue, so Existence(at_exit) must be hard, not soft. The rule-only warning is therefore a symptom: the hard goal is missing from the clause set.
